meta: Make a document checklist for visa or school applications with AI: one missing paper can mean waiting another month.

muc.title: One missing paper, wait again
muc.text: A visa or school application missing one paper can mean waiting another month. AI helps you make a checklist.

muc.title: Start from the official site
muc.text: Open the embassy's or school's official page, copy the document requirements and paste them into a chatbot.

muc.title: Turn it into a checklist
muc.text: Ask the chatbot to make a checklist: document name, original or copy, translation needed or not, deadline.

muc.title: Who has the final say
muc.text: The embassy or school decides; call them about anything unclear. Don't paste your passport number into a chatbot.

muc.title: Tick off what you have
muc.text: Paste the document requirements from the official site, ask a chatbot for a checklist, then tick off what you have.

thu: Paste the document requirements from the official site, ask a chatbot for a checklist, then tick off what you have.
